dietitians.name: Dr. Emily Carter
dietitians.title: Clinical Dietitian
dietitians.bio: I am a registered dietitian with 14 years of experience in managing metabolic nutrition skills, with a special focus on diabetes, heart health, and weight management. I help patients translate clinical goals into meals they can actually keep.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.text: Emily helped me stabilize my glucose without feeling deprived. Clear, kind, and very practical.

reviews.author: James L.
reviews.text: The IBS protocol finally made sense. I had my first comfortable week in months.
